messages:
Lauren: Quick sync — pricing/packaging change implementation: I need owners for metering schema, billing adjustments, quota enforcement, and contract signals. We intend to branch for beta on Friday EOD. @Anya @Matt can you confirm?
Anya: I can own metering schema and ingestion. Need the event contract from product (what fields we must emit). ETA: I can get a PR by Thu AM. Question: do we include per-route tags or only model-level?
Matt: I can take billing mapping and invoice changes. Need metering event sample + rate table. Will depend on metering PR. Plan: block until metering produces sample events. @Izzy will need help on billing job infra.
Izzy: Can help on infra. Need to know expected TPS and whether to run billing job as batch or streaming. Also need quotas gating points: is quota applied at route-level or customer-level?
Lauren: Route-level for commercial plans, customer-level for enterprise. We'll add route tag 'package_tier'. Example event below:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_123",
  "route": "generate_text",
  "model": "redwood-medium-v1",
  "package": "pro",
  "tokens": 42,
  "timestamp": "2025-06-01T14:00:00Z"
}
```
Anya: OK will include package field and route. Also will add optional contract_id for enterprise overrides. PR will include schema and sample events. :+1: 
Priya: Quick legal note — contract constraints for legacy customers: if contract has 'no overage', we need a flag emitted so billing can cap. Use field `contract_no_overage": true` in sample events. Also need retention notes for audit trail (7 years?) — will confirm.
Matt: Good call. We'll add a pre-check: if `contract_no_overage` true then billing won't auto-charge; instead produce invoice with zero overage and flag manual review.
Nora: From solutions side — we need to update onboarding docs and example queries. Can you share example rate table mapping (tokens->USD) so we can show customers? Also need to know quota resets (monthly/calendar vs 30d).
Lauren: We're standardizing on calendar-month reset for public plans; enterprise can request custom windows. Rate table draft: `pro: $0.0004/token`, `team: $0.00035/token`, `enterprise: negotiable`. Sharing spreadsheet in drive: <https://drive.re/redwood/pricing-draft> :eyes: 
Anya: Re TPS — average is 60rps, peak 350rps, but billing events are batched by 1 min windows. For streaming billing we can sample per-request but will default to minute aggregation to cutoff costs.
Izzy: For quotas we'll hook into existing rate-limiter middleware. Two action items for me: 1) add package_tier label propagation, 2) add enforcement middleware that consults quota store with TTL 30s. I'll open PR today.
Matt: FYI I'll add a billing dry-run mode for next week so we can validate invoices without charging. Need a toggle in console; @Lauren can product enablement request be added to the console backlog?
Lauren: Filed ENG-PRD-142 in backlog for console toggle. Also adding test plan: preflight validation + dry-run + audit logs. Owners: Anya (metering), Matt (billing), Izzy (infra), Priya (contracts). Milestone: Beta branch cut Fri EOD; deploy to staging Mon. 
Anya: Sounds good. I'll ping for CR reviews when PR is up. Expect schema PR by Thu 10:00 PT.
Matt: Will queue billing PR review Thu afternoon. :eyes: 
Priya: I'll confirm retention policy by EOD. If anything special for EU customers (GDPR), flag it here.
DeployBot: CI: All checks passed for branch pricing-metrics. Build 8674 ✅
Lauren: Thanks all — please add blockers in thread. If no blockers, we proceed to code-freeze Fri. :zap:
